traits.perianth.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 416: perianth biseriate, a 5-lobed fused calyx and a fused 4- or 5-lobed corolla (formula K (5) C (5)).

traits.carpels.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 416: gynoecium of 2 carpels, divided by false septa into 4 locules (formula G (2)).

traits.ovary_position.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 416: flowers hypogynous, ovary superior and often deeply 4-lobed with a gynobasic style.

traits.hypanthium.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 416: Simpson states the hypanthium is absent and the flowers hypogynous.

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 342 Labiatae: herbs, rarely woody, often scented, the stems usually square; leaves opposite or whorled, simple; no stipules; flowers irregular, rarely almost regular; calyx of 5 joined sepals, often two-lipped; corolla a tube of 4 or 5 lobes, often two-lipped; stamens 4 or 2 on the tube; ovary superior, two carpels deeply lobed with the style from between the lobes; fruit 4 nutlets, read here as a schizocarp of four mericarps. APG's Lamiaceae also takes in woody genera Hutchinson kept in Verbenaceae (family 243: Vitex, Callicarpa, teak), with drupes and some palmately compound leaves: so woody is stated as sometimes, compound leaves as rare and the drupe as sometimes (inferred, not traced). The order (Lamiales) states the stipules, the ovary and the two carpels.

traits.rosette.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Labiatae: whether the leaves gather in rosettes (character 22), coded no rosette. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 21 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.

traits.life_span.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Labiatae: the herbs' life form (character 21), coded often annual, often biennial, often perennial. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 21 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Labiatae: flowers regular or irregular as coded, a state the authors qualify keeping its word (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); the corolla rarely almost regular (Mentha), so actinomorphic is rare.

traits.zygomorphy.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data), family Labiatae: its irregular flowers have a two-lipped corolla, read from the coded corolla symmetry (spec-rework/b1/delta): zygomorphy bilabiate.
